docs.summary: Loads and applies project settings from Echo YAML files in the built player. Reads from Content/Settings/ folder and applies physics, audio, time, and tags/layers.

Applies every project setting and starts XR if the project asks for it. Runs before the first scene loads, so the scene wakes up with them: assets resolved in OnEnable see the budget, navmesh worlds read their settings as their surfaces register, and components can see XR running. Physics settings reach each scene as it loads.
Makes the graphics device for the headset when the project starts XR in the player. Runs before the window opens.
